prompts.roses: Create a high-detail transparent botanical game asset, wide landscape sheet split into TWO equally sized vertical cells with generous transparent gutters. LEFT cell: one naturally branching climbing rose bush rooted in a small weathered terracotta planter, vivid deep red roses mixed with a few blush pink roses, slender woody canes climbing upward and leaning gently to the RIGHT near the top, with realistic serrated rose leaves, tendrils, buds and irregular layered petals. RIGHT cell: a different climbing rose bush in a low terracotta planter, warm buttery yellow roses mixed with soft pink roses, canes leaning LEFT at the top. Both plants tall and airy, leaves and flowers distributed naturally along branches, not balls of flowers or a wedding arch. Real living roses, botanical accuracy, tactile petals and believable leaf veins, delicate warm ink contours and subtle watercolor shading suitable beside an ancient Chinese Song dynasty flower shop in a Qingming handscroll. Rich red pink and yellow accents with soft olive foliage, slightly aged warm tone. Full plants from pot bottom to highest leaf, straight-on view, same baseline, each contained in its half without crossing. Transparent background only: no wall, building, people, floor, shadows, labels, text, border or frames. Crisp separate cutout silhouettes with clean alpha, no glow.
prompts.men: Create a production-quality TRANSPARENT character animation sprite atlas, exactly FIVE columns and THREE rows of equal-size cells, ideally 2560x1536 landscape. Detailed Song dynasty Chinese ordinary people, fine warm ink linework and restrained watercolor colors matching Qingming Riverside handscroll art, natural anatomical proportions, distinct expressive faces, convincing hands and cloth folds. Each row is ONE same man repeated in five poses, full body. Row 1: sturdy middle-aged porter in warm oatmeal short jacket, charcoal loose trousers, cloth shoes, a modest straw hat tied behind his shoulders (not on head). Row 2: dignified older man with short grey beard, grey-blue long robe, dark soft cap and cloth shoes, healthy upright walking posture, no cane. Row 3: young merchant in faded teal cross-collar jacket, brown trousers, black cloth shoes, neat dark hair topknot. All face THREE-QUARTER RIGHT, head height, body proportions, facial identity and clothes must stay EXACTLY consistent across the row; fixed root anchor, shared feet floor baseline, same scale. COLUMN 1 relaxed STANDING idle feet naturally close. COLUMN 2 walk left-foot forward contact with right leg trailing and opposite arm forward. COLUMN 3 passing pose weight on left leg, right leg passing naturally under pelvis. COLUMN 4 walk right-foot forward contact with left leg trailing and opposite arm forward. COLUMN 5 passing pose weight on right leg and left leg under pelvis. Small anatomically normal stride and very subtle arm swing, not marching, no exaggerated bends, no swaying rubber torso. Actual separate feet and leg articulation in every walk pose, consistent faces, no fused limbs. Render in-place, no translating inside cells. High detail for faces and fingers. Generous transparent gutter around every figure, centered in each equal cell, no touching between cells. NO background, checkerboard, paper rectangle, floor, shadow, grid lines, numbers, labels, captions or props bridging cells.

prompts.conversation: Create a high-detail TRANSPARENT animated conversation sprite atlas with exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Each cell contains a full-body pair of Song dynasty Chinese townspeople comfortably talking to each other, fine warm ink linework and muted watercolor, natural faces/hands/anatomy, consistent Qingming Riverside handscroll styling. Each row repeats the SAME pair in four subtle conversational poses with EXACT same body locations, body proportions, heads and feet floor baseline, clothing and identities. Row 1: two standing merchants facing each other, left wears dusty brick-red robe with dark blue cap, right wears slate-blue robe with simple topknot, hands low near waist. Row 2: two standing porters facing each other, left older man with round straw hat and warm brown waistcoat over beige shirt and grey trousers, right younger man in oatmeal jacket, dark trousers, no hat, both normal upright relaxed postures, no cargo and no pointing upward. Row 3: seated tea-house companions on two modest low wooden stools, left older man in dull indigo robe with short grey beard holding a small tea cup, right young man in soft terracotta jacket and pale grey trousers with cup, facing each other. For every row: column 1 quietly listening/resting; column 2 left person's small hand gesture while right listens; column 3 hands relaxed and heads give very slight acknowledgement; column 4 right person's small hand gesture while left listens. Tiny anatomically drawn hand/face changes ONLY; pelvis and feet must not move, no side-to-side sliding, no whole-body scale changes, no rubber deformation. Generous clear gap between the two people and around each pair within its cell; maximum pair width 72 percent of cell width. Both figures fully visible and uncropped. No scenery, floor, shadows, checkerboard, paper, cell borders, labels, numbers or text, genuine clean transparent background.
